title: EXTENSION POINTS -- the one shape both kits declare where, and how, a host extends them
description: Shared by agent-kit and stack-kit (one handwriting): a registry of points, each with its purpose, the host path its file or members go to (`{name}` for a member), the template it is scaffolded from, the schema it keeps, its cardinality, whether the host's profile requires it answered, and how the kit merges it into what it serves. A point is scaffolded on demand; a template carries PENDING markers (`<!-- pending: ... -->`, `"<pending: ...>"`) for the answers only the host gives; a newer template merges three ways into the host's file and never overwrites it. The kit's own copy is never edited. Each kit derives its registry from its own declarations and prints it in this shape.
